title: Build anbox cloud legal pages
body: Build the [privacy notice](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PVV5fpGAS6mPbwmMCM7WVWJxn9MM06aC58khAFs1yII/edit#) and [terms of service](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EPBkBdDHLpg8IR15miZXb_HaaDHtdGQPEgSlbPwySic/edit) pages and add them to the /legal/terms-and-policies page
author: Participant 1
scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
